summary: Frontend testing of Conditional State Highlighting feature. All requested features verified working correctly: Devin Vassell shows 2 OBJECTIVES badge, 47 props, Target-Lock props (PTS OVER 9.5, 3PM OVER 2.5) show Full Intel Suite with DvP/Pace/Stability. LeBron James shows NO objectives badge, 50 props, all basic stats only.

issues: Multiple ERR_HTTP2_PROTOCOL_ERROR console errors for image resources - likely CDN/network issue, not app bug

vassell_2_objectives_badge.description: Devin Vassell shows '2 OBJECTIVES' badge in TacticalPlayerCard header

vassell_47_props.description: Vassell's profile shows 47 available props (verified via API and UI)

vassell_target_lock_pts.description: PTS OVER 9.5 shows OBJECTIVE badge + green glow + Full Intel Suite (DvP #27, Pace, Stability 50)

vassell_target_lock_3pm.description: 3PM OVER 2.5 shows OBJECTIVE badge + green glow + Full Intel Suite (DvP #26, Pace, Stability 50)

vassell_standard_3pm_no_objective.description: 3PM OVER 3.5 and 3PM OVER 1.5 do NOT have OBJECTIVE badge (verified in UI)

vassell_standard_prop_basic_stats.description: Non-Target-Lock props (AST OVER 2.5) show only basic L5/L10/Season stats, no Full Intel Suite

lebron_no_objectives_badge.description: LeBron James (NOT on board) shows NO OBJECTIVES badge (is_on_board: false, target_locks: [])

lebron_50_props.description: LeBron's profile shows 50 available props with basic stats only

lebron_basic_stats_only.description: LeBron's props show only L5/L10/Season stats, no Full Intel Suite

target_lock_sorted_to_top.description: Target-Lock props (is_radar: true) are sorted to top of Prop Arsenal list

critical_code_review_comments: Backend command.py correctly fetches ALL props from dg_live_props and cross-references with dg_radar_picks/dg_goblin_vault/dg_front_lines to set is_radar flag
Frontend TacticalPlayerCard.jsx correctly uses prop.is_radar to determine Full Intel Suite (IntelligenceSuite) vs basic stats (StandardPropStats)
Target-Lock props sorted to top via sortedProps sorting logic in TacticalPlayerCard
targetLockCount calculated correctly to display OBJECTIVES badge
test_credentials: Demo mode at /v3/demo - no login required
context_for_next_testing_agent: Conditional State Highlighting fully verified.
